mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona City Hall, and if you look to the sky tonight, the space station will be visible for 4 minutes starting at 5:47 PM, rising from the west-northwest over Cross Plains and traveling toward the northeast near the Madison Home Depot.

The City of Verona has announced reconstruction plans for several streets including North Shuman and North Marietta scheduled for 2027 and 2028 to replace 1950s-era utility infrastructure, and a public meeting is set for December 16 at City Hall to discuss these improvements.
There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, ART House 360 events tonight, and Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow, plus live music kicking off at Bailey's Run tomorrow.

Regarding local public safety, the Verona Police Department reported that on November 2, a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct following a domestic disturbance call.
Our delicious flavor of the day is Double Strawberry, and since the store is currently open, there is plenty of time to stop by before we close our doors at 10:00 PM.
